## Context

JWT rotation today is global. For multi-tenant we want per-tenant
isolation without shipping N secrets.

## Decision

Derive per-tenant signing keys via HKDF(masterSecret, tenantId).

## Consequences

Compromise of one tenant key does not leak others. Adds derivation cost
to every issuance.
